__NOTOC__
The term '''''Wheel of Time''''' can refer to the following:

*''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' - the title of the book series.
*The [[Wheel of Time]] - a concept within the series.
*''[[The Wheel of Time (book)]]'' - an in-universe historical document from the [[Fourth Age]]

==Related works==
*''[[The Complete Wheel of Time]]'' - Omnibus ebook containing all of the novels, including {{0}}.
*''[[The Wheel of Time Collectible Card Game]]'' - a card game based on the series.
*[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game|''The Wheel of Time'' Roleplaying Game]] - an RPG based on the series.
*[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|''The Wheel of Time'' video game]] - a video game based on the series.
*[[The Wheel of Time translations|''The Wheel of Time'' translations]] - a collection of all of the languages into which the series has been translated.
*''[[The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time]]'' - the first companion book to the series.
*''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]'' - the second companion book to the series.
*[[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|''The Wheel of Time'' TV series]] - a television adaptation of the series.
*''[[Origins of the Wheel of Time]]'' - An exegetic study of the series and [[Robert Jordan]]

==Websites==
*[[The Wheel of Time Concordance|''The Wheel of Time'' Concordance]] - a website guide to the geography and culture of the series.
*[[Wheel of Time Database|''Wheel of Time'' Database]] - a searchable database of the series.
*[[Wheel of Time FAQ|''Wheel of Time'' FAQ]] - one of the oldest sites dedicated to the series.
*[[Wheel of Time MUD|''Wheel of Time'' MUD]] - an online multi-user game.
